title: Dashboard Tour
text: SCI score, decision band, per-pillar score cards. Overview: SCI pillar scores
code: scores_vec <- setNames(pillar_scores$pillar_score, pillar_scores$pillar)  band_col <- c(ready = "#27AE60", minor_gaps = "#F39C12",               conditional = "#E67E22", high_risk = "#E74C3C")[[sci$band]]  # Save the caller's graphics parameters; restored in the final chunk. oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE) par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 5, 3, 1))  barplot(sci$SCI, col = band_col, border = NA, xlim = c(0, 100),         horiz = TRUE, axes = FALSE,         main = paste0("SCI  =  ", round(sci$SCI, 1))) axis(1, at = c(0, 50, 70, 85, 100)) abline(v = c(70, 85), lty = 2, col = "#888888") mtext(sci$band, side = 1, line = 2.5, col = band_col, font = 2)  barplot(scores_vec[names(cols)], col = cols[names(scores_vec)],         border = NA, ylim = c(0, 1), las = 1,         ylab = "Score", main = "Pillar Scores") abline(h = 0.85, lty = 2, col = "#555555")

title: Dashboard Tour
text: Set target SCI see gap , plus pillar lift score (biggest lever). Targets: gap target SCI biggest levers
code: target  <- 85 gap     <- sci_gap_to_target(sci, target) levers  <- gap$pillars  # pillar, current, weight, max_lift (ordered by max_lift)  par(mar = c(4, 7, 3, 2)) barplot(rev(setNames(levers$max_lift, levers$pillar)),         horiz = TRUE, las = 1, col = rev(cols[levers$pillar]), border = NA,         xlab = "SCI points available",         main = paste0("Biggest Levers  |  Gap to SCI ", target,                       " = ", round(gap$gap, 1)))

title: Dashboard Tour
text: Filterable table evidence rows. Evidence: result distribution pillar
code: with(ev, table(indicator_domain, result)) #>                 result #> indicator_domain fail na pass warn #>        quality     26 14   55   25 #>        risk         6  2   24    7 #>        trace        9  1   29    8 #>        usability    8  3   26    7 domains     <- c("quality", "trace", "risk", "usability") results     <- c("pass", "warn", "fail") result_cols <- c(pass = "#27AE60", warn = "#F39C12", fail = "#E74C3C")  mat <- sapply(results, function(r)   sapply(domains, function(d)     sum(ev$indicator_domain == d & ev$result == r, na.rm = TRUE)   ) )  par(mar = c(4, 7, 3, 6)) barplot(t(mat), beside = TRUE, col = result_cols,         names.arg = domains, las = 1, border = NA,         ylab = "Count", main = "Evidence Results by Pillar") legend("topright", legend = results, fill = result_cols,        border = NA, bty = "n", inset = c(-0.18, 0), xpd = TRUE)

title: Dashboard Tour
text: SCI stability alternative pillar weight scenarios. SCI sensitivity weight variations
code: weight_grid <- data.frame(   quality   = c(0.35, 0.50, 0.25, 0.25),   trace     = c(0.25, 0.20, 0.40, 0.25),   risk      = c(0.25, 0.20, 0.25, 0.25),   usability = c(0.15, 0.10, 0.10, 0.25) ) scenario_labels <- c("Default", "Quality-heavy", "Trace-heavy", "Equal")  sens <- sci_sensitivity_analysis(ev, weight_grid)  par(mar = c(4, 11, 3, 2)) barplot(setNames(sens$SCI, scenario_labels),         horiz = TRUE, las = 1, col = "#2C6DB5", border = NA,         xlim = c(0, 100), xlab = "SCI",         main = "SCI by Weight Scenario") abline(v = c(70, 85), lty = 2, col = "#888888")

title: Dashboard Tour
text: Risk distribution severity level
code: data(risk_register_pharma) rr          <- create_risk_register(risk_register_pharma) risk_sc     <- compute_risk_scores(rr)  rd        <- risk_sc$risk_distribution risk_cols <- c(low = "#27AE60", medium = "#F39C12",                high = "#E67E22", critical = "#E74C3C") rd_named  <- setNames(rd$n, rd$risk_level) rd_plot   <- rd_named[intersect(names(risk_cols), names(rd_named))]  par(mar = c(4, 5, 3, 2)) barplot(rd_plot, col = risk_cols[names(rd_plot)], border = NA,         ylab = "Count", las = 1,         main = paste0("Risk Distribution  |  Mean RPN = ", risk_sc$mean_rpn))

title: Dashboard Tour
text: FMEA: Pareto risk priority numbers register, RPN, Pareto shares produced r4subrisk; FMEA tab orders displays .
code: pareto <- risk_pareto(rr)  par(mar = c(4, 5, 3, 5)) bp <- barplot(pareto$rpn, names.arg = pareto$rank, border = NA,               col = ifelse(pareto$vital_few, "#2C6DB5", "#AEB6BF"),               ylab = "RPN", xlab = "Risk (ranked by RPN)", las = 1,               ylim = c(0, max(pareto$rpn) * 1.1),               main = paste0("Risk Pareto  |  vital few = ",                             attr(pareto, "n_vital_few"))) lines(bp, pareto$cum_share * max(pareto$rpn) * 1.1, type = "o",       pch = 16, col = "#E74C3C", lwd = 2)

title: Dashboard Tour
text: Traceability: result distribution
code: data(adam_metadata); data(sdtm_metadata); data(trace_mapping) ctx      <- r4sub_run_context(study_id = "CDISCPILOT01", environment = "DEV") #> ℹ Run context created: "R4S-20261115073107-wl4dieex" tm       <- build_trace_model(adam_metadata, sdtm_metadata, trace_mapping) ev_trace <- trace_model_to_evidence(tm, ctx = ctx) #> ✔ Evidence table created: 47 rows  res_counts <- table(ev_trace$result) trace_cols <- c(pass = "#27AE60", warn = "#F39C12",                 fail = "#E74C3C", na = "#BDC3C7") rc <- res_counts[intersect(names(trace_cols), names(res_counts))]  par(mar = c(4, 5, 3, 2)) barplot(rc, col = trace_cols[names(rc)], border = NA,         ylab = "Count", las = 1,         main = paste0("Trace Results  |  ", nrow(ev_trace), " indicators"))

code: before <- generate_demo_evidence(60, seed = 1) #> ℹ Run context created: "R4S-20261115073107-da7wnr6u" #> ✔ Evidence table created: 60 rows after  <- generate_demo_evidence(60, seed = 2) #> ℹ Run context created: "R4S-20261115073107-uoff5hq2" #> ✔ Evidence table created: 60 rows  cmp <- compare_readiness(before, after)  # Headline SCI and decision-band move. c(before = cmp$sci$before, after = cmp$sci$after, delta = cmp$sci$delta) #> before  after  delta  #>   44.9   32.6  -12.3  # Per-pillar score change (largest movers first). cmp$pillars #>      pillar score_before score_after       delta weight #> 1   quality    0.4916667   0.2800000 -0.21166667   0.35 #> 2 usability    0.5173611   0.3458333 -0.17152778   0.15 #> 3     trace    0.4562500   0.3854167 -0.07083333   0.25 #> 4      risk    0.3395833   0.3174603 -0.02212302   0.25  # How many indicators improved or regressed. cmp$diff_summary[c("n_improved", "n_regressed", "net_delta")] #>  n_improved n_regressed   net_delta  #>      24.000      39.000      -4.125

title: Compare Submission Readiness Between Two Evidence Snapshots — compare_readiness
text: Compares baseline evidence snapshot current one returns change headline readiness: Submission Confidence Index (SCI) delta, decision-band move, per-pillar score deltas, row-level evidence diff summary (many indicators added, removed, improved, regressed).

title: Compare Submission Readiness Between Two Evidence Snapshots — compare_readiness
Compare Submission Readiness Between Two Evidence Snapshots — compare_readiness
text: baseline validated evidence data.frame taken earlier ("") snapshot, one produced generate_demo_evidence(). current validated evidence data.frame taken later ("") snapshot. diff computed baseline -> current, improvement current shows positive net_delta.

title: Compare Submission Readiness Between Two Evidence Snapshots — compare_readiness
text: named list elements: sci list SCI values delta (- ). band list decision bands logical changed flag. n_critical list critical-finding counts delta. pillars data.frame one row per pillar: pillar, score_before, score_after, delta, weight, ordered size move (largest absolute delta first). diff row-level r4subcore::evidence_diff() data.frame changed, added, removed indicators. diff_summary named numeric vector r4subcore::evidence_diff_summary() metrics (example n_improved, n_regressed, net_delta).

title: Compare Submission Readiness Between Two Evidence Snapshots — compare_readiness
text: pure, non-reactive helper behind dashboard's Compare tab. surfaces values engine packages already compute (r4subscore::compute_pillar_scores(), r4subscore::compute_sci(), r4subcore::evidence_diff() / r4subcore::evidence_diff_summary()); define new scoring regulatory semantics. plain data-frame-, list-function shiny dependency, easy unit test .
